state.seed_assertion: Improper pull-up resistors and incorrect clock edge timing in handshake lines can cause intermittent faults from residual signal states and noise interaction.

sentences.1: Improper pull-up resistors and incorrect clock edge timing in handshake lines can cause intermittent faults from residual signal states and noise interaction.
sentences.2: The problem was related to some handshake lines with improper pull-ups and the use of the wrong edge of a clock on one of the processors that reduced the settling time for the handshake line.
sentences.3: The stalled processor ended up seeing the remnants of transfer acknowledge for the first processor, aided by a bit of noise.
sentences.4: Machine signals run live onto the display at the line and are recorded in the Peakboard Hub for long-term analysis of availability, downtime durations and OEE.
sentences.5: The signals run live onto the display at the line and are recorded in the Peakboard Hub, so availability, downtime durations and OEE stay analysable across weeks.
sentences.6: The edge device connects to the line in read-only mode without requiring new controllers or PLC modifications.
sentences.7: 02The Edge connects read-only One appliance beside the line.
sentences.8: Variable Frequency Drives and large contactors generate high-frequency noise that travels through power lines into sensitive control circuits, where transients are misinterpreted as actual data.
sentences.9: Gathering information from line-level technicians who observe intermittent issues can provide valuable clues for troubleshooting.
sentences.10: Near-field H probes can be used to detect ground noise, EMI, and poor switching power supply designs from a distance of half an inch or more.
sentences.11: Making incorrect changes to safety systems creates liability issues and actual safety risks.
sentences.12: Understanding fundamental physics and transmission line theory can significantly aid in troubleshooting intermittent faults, particularly in switching power supplies.
